title: AI Security
scope: AI coding assistants, MCP tools, autonomous agents, and LLM product features
abstract: Secure-by-default guardrails for using AI coding assistants and shipping LLM features: keep secrets and PII out of prompts and indexes, verify AI-suggested packages against registries (anti-slopsquatting), treat issues/web/MCP as untrusted context, require human-in-the-loop and sandboxed least-privilege agents, and sanitize LLM outputs while never using models for authorization. Grounded in OWASP LLM Top 10 2026, Agentic ASI 2026, MCP security best practices, NIST SP 800-218A, and vendor ignore/ZDR docs. Complements the SaaS security skill; defensive only.
